text:
The wind blows hard tonight

And it is a cold wind

And I think of the boys

On the street.

I hope some of them have

A bottle of red wine.


When you are on the street

That is when you realize that

Everything

Has an owner

And that there are locks on

Everything.

This is how democracy works:

You take what you can,

Try to keep it

And add something

If possible.


This is also how

Dictatorship works

Only one enslaves

And the other destroys its

Disinherited.


We simply forget

Our own.


In any case

It is a wind

Hard

And cold.

translation.title: The Wind Blows Hard Tonight...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the street-level comparison of democracy, dictatorship, ownership, and forgetting the dispossessed.
